patterns.language: The evaluation shall address each of the issues described in the panel QME's report
criteria: Address all issues in panel report
Provide medical opinion on each contested issue

patterns.language: Permanent disability shall be determined in accordance with the AMA Guides
Industrial causation must be established to a reasonable degree of medical probability
criteria: State opinion to reasonable medical probability

patterns.language: Apportionment shall be based on causation

reasoning_examples.pattern: The mechanism of injury involving {mechanism} is consistent with {diagnosis}. The temporal relationship between injury and symptom onset supports industrial causation.
reasoning_examples.causation: It is my opinion to a reasonable degree of medical probability that the {condition} is causally related to the industrial injury of {date}.

reasoning_examples.pattern: The injury to the {body_part} involving {mechanism} resulted in {pathology}. The examination findings of {findings} are consistent with the reported mechanism.
reasoning_examples.causation: Based on reasonable medical probability, the {condition} is industrially related given the mechanism of injury and temporal relationship.
recommendations: Physical therapy for range of motion and strengthening

templates.history_template: The patient reports sustaining an injury on {date} when {mechanism}. Initially, the patient experienced {initial_symptoms}. Currently, the patient describes {current_symptoms}.
templates.examination_template: Physical examination reveals {general_appearance}. Range of motion testing shows {rom_findings}. Strength testing demonstrates {strength_findings}. Neurological examination reveals {neuro_findings}.
templates.diagnosis_template: Based on the history, physical examination, and review of medical records, the diagnosis is {primary_diagnosis} (ICD-10: {icd_code}).
templates.impairment_template: Using the AMA Guides to the Evaluation of Permanent Impairment, 5th Edition, {methodology}, the impairment rating is {percentage}% whole person impairment.
templates.causation_template: It is my opinion to a reasonable degree of medical probability that the {condition} is causally related to the industrial injury of {date} based on {rationale}.
templates.treatment_template: Future medical care recommendations include: {recommendations}. These treatments are reasonable and necessary for the diagnosed condition.
templates.restrictions_template: Based on the examination findings and functional limitations, the following work restrictions are recommended: {restrictions}.
